# OCR assets

Tesseract.js 6.0.1 and tesseract.js-core 6.0.0: Apache-2.0 (licenses included). Bundled dependency notices: LICENSE-bundle-dependencies.txt and LICENSE-worker-dependencies.txt.

English trained data: @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0, 4.0.0_best_int/eng.traineddata.gz. npm package metadata declares MIT; upstream Tesseract English trained data is from https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best (Apache-2.0). The Apache-2.0 license text is included as LICENSE-core.txt.

Archives were downloaded from the official npm registry with TLS verification and verified against their SHA-512 integrity values. manifest.json records the exact sources, archive integrity and SHA-256 of retained files. No third-party runtime CDN requests are needed. No screenshots are sent to Tesseract services.
